D3.name: 要求适配与跨轮一致性

checks: opens as valid readable UTF-8 text

L.role: maker-seen reproduction; never independent unseen benefit evidence
explicit_requirements: latest explicit limit 600 characters or fewer
preserve source user address/self-name style in suitable dialogue context
derived_quality_items_are_not_explicit_u: core facts and qualifiers remain accurate
relevant major aspects are covered without requiring every optional detail
no invented external verification or unperformed file insertion
L.length_measurement: Report source text as ordinary visible Unicode character count including punctuation and whitespace; also expose count excluding whitespace and keep exact source term 600字以内. Borderline counting ambiguity is reported, not silently resolved in favor of an arm.
L.dialogue_style_scope: A source persona greeting belongs to suitable dialogue and need not pollute the official report body. If method-blind review sees only the deliverable and not the final dialogue reply, mark this item outside assessed scope rather than infer it failed. Any redaction of final dialogue method hints must be explicit and preserve original separately.

E.role: new train-development consumption source whose body was absent from B maker inputs; not a final heldout test
explicit_requirements: make supplied five-part institutional engineering rationale concise
derived_quality_items_are_not_explicit_u: preserve the five distinct reasons or an equivalent clear concise organization
no unsupported new achievements or stronger exclusive hiring claim
